question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Demolish
solution: The correct answer is option 3), i.e., 'Ruin.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Let's look at the meaning of the given word: Word Meaning Example Demolish to completely destroy a building, especially in order to use the land for something else. (ध्वस्त करना) A bomb demolishes a city by exploding and causing widespread damage. • ​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options: Word Meaning Example Create to make something new or original. (बनाना) A programmer creates a software program by writing code. Fabricate to make up a story or an excuse; to construct or manufacture something, especially from prepared components. (निर्माण करना) A liar fabricates a story by making up events that never happened. Ruin to completely destroy or devastate something; to cause something to fail or collapse. (किसी चीज को पूरी तरह से नष्ट करना) A natural disaster can ruin a city by destroying buildings and infrastructure. Shape the particular physical form or appearance of something. (आकार) A sculptor shapes marble into a statue by carving away the excess material until the desired shape is revealed. • Clearly, the word 'Ruin' is closest in meaning to the given word 'Demolish.' • Therefore, the correct synonym of the given word is option 3. 3c:T1d65,
